description: A VisionSearch Agent that autonomously performs tasks by processing diverse data with image recognition tools to identify objects, patterns, or text; OCR for extracting text from images or documents; and search engines/web browsers for real-time online information—supporting visual search, automated tagging, content analysis, and comprehensive research with accurate results.

tools.name: ImageRecognitionTool
tools.description: A tool that utilizes advanced image recognition algorithms to identify objects, patterns, and features in images, enabling visual search capabilities.

tools.name: OCRTool
tools.description: Optical Character Recognition tool that extracts text from images or documents, converting visual information into editable and searchable text.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool that allows the agent to navigate the web, retrieve information, and interact with web pages in real-time for comprehensive research.

tools.name: SearchEngine
tools.description: A search engine tool that enables the agent to perform queries and retrieve relevant information from the internet based on user input or identified needs.

tools.name: DataAnalysisTool
tools.description: A tool that processes and analyzes data to extract insights, trends, and patterns, supporting informed decision-making.

tools.name: AutomatedTaggingTool
tools.description: A tool that automatically tags content based on recognized patterns and identified objects, facilitating organization and retrieval.
